observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration parameter `lookback_days` to the DAG configuration, with a default of 14 days, and propagates it through the DAG execution and command invocation.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the AI enrichment scheduling DAG to filter organizations based on how recently their data was fetched, preventing stale or outdated records from being processed.

observations.behavior: Updates the `count_pending_candidates` function to accept the `lookback_days` parameter and uses a filtered queryset `recent_latest_fetches_qs` instead of the unfiltered `latest_fetches_qs`.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the candidate selection logic to only consider organizations whose latest data fetch occurred within the configured lookback window, rather than all available organizations.

observations.behavior: Updates the `_run_one_label` function to accept and pass the `lookback_days` parameter to the downstream batch command.
observations.posthog_connection: Propagates the lookback configuration from the DAG execution context to the command execution, ensuring the filtering is applied at the command level.
